requirement_table.text: ID register at 0x000 reads 0x20940001.
BUILD register at 0x004 reads the USR_ACCESSE2 word.
SCRATCH at 0x008 reads back the last value written.
SCRATCH resets to 0.
Unmapped addresses read 0.
Writes to unmapped addresses change no register.
h_rdata shows the addressed register within 2 clocks of h_re.
h_rdata holds the addressed register value until the next h_re.
Each output equals saturate16((sum of h[k]*x[n-k] + 0x4000) >>> 15) bit for bit against the Python model for an impulse.
Each output matches the Python model bit for bit for a step input.
Each output matches the Python model bit for bit for 10000 random samples sent in chunks of 1000 with no CLEAR.
Samples before the first one are 0 after CLEAR.
Filter history persists across RUN commands until CLEAR.
The datapath uses 16 multipliers for 32 symmetric taps, mapped to DSP slices.
The datapath accepts one sample per clk_dsp cycle.
clk_dsp closes timing at 250 MHz or faster with WNS >= 0.
The build report shows the DSP slice count.
The build report shows the achieved datapath clock.
IN_PUSH stores the low 16 bits of the write data as a sample.
IN_PUSH is ignored when the input FIFO holds 1024 samples.
OUT_POP returns bit 31 = 1 and bits 15:0 = the oldest output.
An OUT_POP read removes the oldest output from the output FIFO.
OUT_POP returns 0 when the output FIFO is empty.
STATUS bit 0 is 1 while a run is in progress and 0 otherwise.
STATUS bits 15:4 equal the input FIFO count from 0 to 1024.
STATUS bits 31:20 equal the output FIFO count from 0 to 1024.
SAT_COUNT counts the outputs that saturated since CLEAR.
SAMPLES_DONE counts the samples processed since CLEAR.
CTRL bit 0 empties both FIFOs.
CTRL bit 0 zeroes the filter history.
CTRL bit 0 zeroes SAT_COUNT.
CTRL bit 0 zeroes SAMPLES_DONE.
CTRL bit 0 reads 0 after the write.
CTRL bit 1 starts processing of the input FIFO.
CTRL bit 1 reads 0 after the write.
sfp_tx_disable is 1 at all times.
The design uses no GT transceiver channel.
data/jtag_bus.sv is used unchanged.
The 25 MHz clock is constrained on pin C3.
